Reporting configuration

Source: R/config.R
tlf_config.Rd

tlf_config() bundles every organization-level convention: page geometry, fonts, the running page header, the figure palette, treatment-variable candidates and the figure render policy. The defaults are neutral; an organization usually sets its own once per session (see tlf_get_config()).

Usage

tlf_config(
  page = tlf_page(),
  fonts = tlf_fonts(),
  header_left = "",
  header_right = "Page \\pagenumber of \\pagefield",
  palette = tol_bright,
  trt_candidates = c("TRT01A", "TRTA", "TRT01P", "TRTP", "ARM", "ACTARM"),
  render = tlf_render_opts(),
  text_convert = FALSE
)

Arguments

page

A tlf_page() object.

fonts

A tlf_fonts() object.

header_left

Text of the left cell of the running page header, for example an organization name. "" means no left cell.

header_right

Text of the right cell. r2rtf page fields \\pagenumber and \\pagefield are expanded.

palette

Colours used for treatment groups in figures.

trt_candidates

Treatment/grouping variables tried, in order, when the requested treatment variable is absent from the data.

render

A tlf_render_opts() object.

text_convert

Let r2rtf convert LaTeX-like markup in text (for example _ to a subscript, >= to a symbol)? The default FALSE prints all text verbatim, so titles stay character-identical to their metadata source and program names such as t_demo.R are not mangled.

Value

An object of class tlf_config.

Examples

cfg <- tlf_config(header_left = "Example Organization")
cfg$fonts$text_family
#> [1] "Courier New"
